name: cli-structured-multi-fault-invocation-diagnostics
instr:
urfave/cli cannot currently collect every safely recoverable invocation error in one run with its cause and occurrence context. Add opt-in structured multi-fault diagnostics while preserving fail-fast invocation, default-command, usage, help, and completion behavior by default.

Collection returns one ordered `DiagnosticError`. Its `FlagDiagnostic` entries preserve argv order, command lineage, canonical flag identity, spelling, value, position, category, and wrapped cause for typed flags, `BoolWithInverseFlag`, and standard-library adapters. Keep conversion, validation, duplication, inverse conflict, unknown or missing input, lifecycle, and external-source failures distinct. Do not infer unsupported flag capabilities.

Consume each failing occurrence completely. Respect aliases, short-option clusters, equals syntax, double-dash termination, `StopOnNthArg`, persistent flags, and `DefaultCommand` dispatch without reclassifying positional input. Any diagnostic suppresses flag actions, argument validation, `Before`, `Action`, and `After`; collect safely discoverable lifecycle faults too.

`Run` and `OnUsageError` must see identical immutable, MultiError-compatible ordering and cause relationships. Preserve custom replacement-error behavior. Suggest only eligible unknown flags. Render each diagnostic once before the correct help. During shell completion, treat partial flags and missing values as context, emit no diagnostics, run no action, and retain no state.

Preserve argv order
